topic: The role of arts activities in developing resilience and mental wellbeing in children and young people a rapid review of the literature

sources.title: The role of arts activities in developing resilience and mental wellbeing in children and young people a rapid review of the literature

findings.finding: Arts activities contribute to building resilience by improving self-confidence and self-esteem in young people.
findings.quote: It was found that participating in arts activities can have a positive effect on self-confidence, self-esteem, relationship building and a sense of belonging, qualities which have been associated with resilience and mental wellbeing.

findings.finding: Group arts participation supports relationship building and creates a sense of belonging.
findings.quote: participating in arts activities can have a positive effect on self-confidence, self-esteem, relationship building and a sense of belonging

principle: Participating in structured group arts activities can positively affect self-confidence, self-esteem, relationship building, and a sense of belonging among young people.
for_the_teacher: Encourage group participation to foster a sense of belonging and relationship building among learners.
when_it_does_not_apply: The review focuses specifically on children and young people aged between 11 and 18 years participating in community or extracurricular school settings.
